name: Build Island
desc:
[NEW] Share your builds seamlessly with your friends or the world!  Additionally, three new modkits have been added to enhance your builds.

💸 Earn Robux while playing with Donation Stand items. Donations are made through your T-Shirts and Gamepasses and may take up to a week to receive: https://www.roblox.com/transactions 

Create the world of your imagination and share it with others in Build Island, the hottest building game on Roblox. What will you create?

BI Commands Guide: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/admin-commands-guide/808913

Create mods with the ModKit https://www.roblox.com/library/6160073881/ModKit

Help us test upcoming versions of the game! https://www.roblox.com/games/5673340193/Dev-Server/

Made with permission and help from CloneTrooper1019. Play WTRB! https://www.roblox.com/games/2897155393/WTRB
